issues.issue: The text adds a definition ('defined as CMV end-organ disease or initiation of anti-CMV pre-emptive therapy based on documented CMV viremia') that is not present in the cited quote, which only states the endpoint through Week 24 (prophylaxis failure).
The result mislabels the -23.5 (95% CI -32.5, -14.6) difference as 'stratum-adjusted'; the cited quote only says 'Difference (95% CI) -23.5 (-32.5, -14.6)' without stating it is stratum-adjusted.

Internal inconsistency: the approval_program.summary citation states efficacy is supported by 'one phase 3 trial (P001)' AND 'one phase 2b dose-ranging trial (P020),' but only one pivotal trial is described in pivotal_trials.
The lead citation says 'Most common adverse events' whereas the field text says 'adverse reactions'; minor wording mismatch but the AE rates and thresholds are otherwise supported.
